meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create or update AgentSkills. Use when designing, structuring, or packaging skills with scripts, references, and assets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建或更新 AgentSkills，打包脚本、引用和资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计、结构化或打包 AgentSkills
copy.tagline_en: Create or update AgentSkills with scripts, references, and assets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design, structure, or package AgentSkills

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以按照指南创建或更新 AgentSkills，包括设计结构、打包脚本、参考资料和资源文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计、构建或打包一个技能，或者需要将脚本、文档等资源组织成技能包时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个名为“pdf-editor”的技能，包含旋转PDF的脚本。
say.note: Claude 会运行初始化脚本并生成技能目录。

say.text: 为我的“big-query”技能添加一个引用文件，记录表结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create or update AgentSkills by following the guide, including structuring, packaging scripts, references, and assets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to design, build, or package a skill, or to organize scripts, documents, etc., into a skill package.

say_en.text: Create a skill named 'pdf-editor' with a script to rotate PDFs.
say_en.note: Claude will run the init script and generate the skill directory.

say_en.text: Add a reference file documenting table schemas to my 'big-query' skill.
say_en.note: Claude will create references/schema.md in the skill package.
